节点#1 RH_RhartImageG2OfficialImageToImage
作用：调用 ImageG2 官方图生图接口：接收参考图与提示词参数，执行重绘/编辑生成并输出新图，供保存或后续处理分支继续使用。
参数：
- prompt：当前值=【Image Roles — Dual Reference System】\nImage 1 (P…；作用：主编辑提示词，描述目标结果；范围：字符串，建议 1 ~ 2048 字符；默认：空字符串。
- resolution：当前值=2k；作用：选择输出分辨率档位（清晰度越高，耗时和显存通常越高）；范围：预设尺寸下拉列表（如 720p / 1080p）；默认：720p（常见默认）。
- quality：当前值=medium；作用：设置 `quality` 使用的文本或选项值，节点会按该值选择对应处理方式；范围：下拉枚举（从节点给出的候选项中选择）；默认：通常为 auto 或节点作者设定项。
- aspectRatio：当前值=3:4；作用：控制画面宽高比，决定横竖构图和主体留白；范围：下拉枚举（如 16:9 / 9:16 / 3:4）；默认：auto。
- skip_error：当前值=False；作用：遇到单次接口报错时是否跳过并继续后续流程；范围：布尔值：true/false；默认：false。
- seed：当前值=552140004；作用：随机种子，控制可复现性；范围：整数，常见 0 ~ 2^63-1；默认：0。

【Image Roles — Dual Reference System】
Image 1 (Product Master) : Sole authority for garment design, color, material, proportions, and all product details. Every visible element in the final output must match Image 1 exactly.
Image 2 (Pose & Atmosphere Reference) : Use only for floating pose, three-quarter perspective, spatial depth, fabric movement, and lighting atmosphere. Do not inherit color, fabric sheen, construction, or decorative details from Image 2.
【Task Definition】
Transform the pants from Image 1 into a realistic model-free floating product photograph using the dynamic perspective and lighting atmosphere of Image 2. This is an image-editing task, not a garment redesign.
【Product Details — Strictly Locked】
Preserve from Image 1 without any modification:
Color: Warm ivory/off-white
Fabric: Soft, matte, low-luster textile
Silhouette: Original loose straight-leg cut
Waistband: Original height, width, elastic gathering pattern, and stitch density
Rise & Proportions: Original rise depth, crotch depth, leg length and width
Pockets: Both side pockets with exact openings, depth, stitching, and placement
Cuffs: Dark charcoal piping around both trouser cuffs; original cuff width, construction, stitching, and thickness
Construction: Original labels, seams, and all visible details
Prohibited: Adding, removing, simplifying, or redesigning any part. Inheriting pink color, satin sheen, garment construction, branding, or decorative details from Image 2.
【Floating Pose & Perspective — Critical Control】
Create a genuine asymmetrical three-quarter floating perspective (not flat front view, not symmetrical hanging pose):
Waistband Orientation:
Structurally stable, almost horizontal
Slopes gently downward toward viewer-right by approximately 8–12 degrees
Do not make it perfectly horizontal, strongly arched, twisted, or tilted in opposite direction
Rotate upper hip and crotch plane consistently with waistband tilt
Waistband Alignment Rule: Waistband top edge, pocket openings, center rise line, crotch seam, and upper-leg folds must all share the same three-dimensional perspective plane.
Viewer-Left Leg (farther from viewer):
Sweeps broadly downward and toward viewer-left in smooth extended curve
Projects slightly forward and outward
Cuff positioned higher than viewer-right cuff, mildly foreshortened
Cuff opening appears slightly narrower/smaller due to distance
Viewer-Right Leg (closer to viewer):
Remains closer to main vertical axis
Descends more vertically with gentle outward curve
Cuff positioned lower, slightly closer to viewer, subtly larger than left cuff
Leg Relationship: Clear front-to-back depth between legs. Legs must not look like two flat parallel strips on the same plane.
Crotch Area: Anatomically and structurally plausible. Preserve original rise depth. Avoid stretching, pinching, splitting, or unnatural empty hole.
Overall Silhouette: Asymmetrical flowing three-quarter composition
Viewer-left: Higher and more outward
Viewer-right: Lower and more vertical
Dynamic but controlled, elegant, soft, commercially realistic
Prohibited: Symmetric A-shape, inverted V pose, parallel vertical legs, exaggerated dancing pose.
【Fabric Folds & Drape】
Generate long, soft gravity-informed folds beginning naturally from elastic waistband, pocket area, and crotch. Folds continue smoothly down each leg, reinforcing curved direction.
Viewer-Left Leg: Slightly stronger sweeping folds to show forward movement.
Viewer-Right Leg: Quieter, longer vertical folds to maintain structural stability.
Fabric Quality: Soft, lightweight, matte. Highlights broad and diffused, never sharp or metallic.
Prohibited: Random wrinkles, repeated artificial folds, sharp origami creases, inflated tube-shaped legs, melted/liquid fabric, overly smooth plastic surfaces, glossy satin highlights, thick heavy curtain-like draping.
【Trouser-Cuff Construction — Critical Detail】
Preserve both original straight trouser-cuff constructions exactly:
Dark piping remains at same distance from bottom edge, following three-dimensional curvature of each cuff
Each cuff opening becomes natural shallow ellipse due to perspective
Viewer-left cuff: Slightly more foreshortened, positioned higher
Viewer-right cuff: Positioned lower, faces viewer slightly more, shows subtly greater depth
Preserve original cuff width, seam position, piping thickness, fabric thickness
Both trouser legs remain same original physical length (different apparent heights come only from pose and perspective)
Prohibited: Flared/bell-bottom openings, tapered ankles, rolled cuffs, gathered cuffs, thick rigid rings, oversized hollow tubes, detached fabric layers, uneven/mismatched cuff designs. Piping must not disappear, double, break, float away from seam, or change color.
【Pockets & Waistband】
Pockets: Retain both original side pockets. Pocket openings follow rotated hip plane (not artificially symmetrical after pants tilt). Preserve original pocket size, depth, stitching, and placement.
Waistband: Elastic waistband shows fine, soft, evenly distributed gathers.
Prohibited: Drawstring waist, paper-bag waist, ribbed knit band, rigid belt. Do not add drawstrings, buttons, zippers, belt loops, or decorative elements.
【Lighting — Commercial Studio Quality】
Clean high-key commercial studio lighting:
Key Light: One very large diffused light from upper-left, slightly in front of garment
Fill Light: Broad, soft frontal fill from viewer-right to preserve ivory color and reveal construction details in shadows
Light Wrapping: Soft wrap around fabric, revealing volume through gentle tonal transitions
Required Qualities:
Neutral white balance
Clean ivory highlights
Soft light-gray translucent shadows
Broad low-contrast highlights
Subtle depth inside folds
Controlled edge separation from background
Fabric remains matte and soft with restrained highlights
Prohibited: Flat gray lighting, dark muddy shadows, green/blue/yellow/pink color casts, strong directional spotlighting, hard-edged shadows, metallic reflections, plastic shine, glossy satin highlights, heavy contrast, overexposed white areas with lost fabric detail, artificial HDR clarity.
【Background & Floating Shadow】
Background: Clean pale gray-white seamless studio background with very subtle central light gradient.
Floating Effect: Pants fully suspended in open space, no visible contact with ground.
Shadow: Broad, diffused, low-opacity floating shadow behind and slightly below garment. Shadow is soft, light gray, separated from pants, consistent with upper-left key light. Indicates spatial depth without appearing like floor shadow.
Prohibited: Visible floor line, ground contact, hard drop shadows, mirror reflections, dark halos, heavy vignette, background texture, hangers, clips, wires, mannequin parts, human body parts, support objects, props.
【Composition & Output】
Aspect Ratio: Vertical 2:3
Resolution: Preferably 2048 × 3072 pixels if supported
Framing: Complete pants visible (both waistband and cuffs fully shown), comfortable clean margins around garment
Scale: Pants occupy approximately 72–80% of canvas height
Positioning: Visual center slightly above canvas center (allow space for lower floating shadow)
Detail: Sharp, natural product detail without blocky grain, excessive sharpening, fake texture, or compression artifacts
【Final Result】
Premium, photorealistic e-commerce floating product photograph of the exact pants from Image 1, using only the pose, perspective, spatial movement, and lighting atmosphere from Image 2.
